heading: Bring us the opportunity. We’ll make it happen.
intro: Landowners, investors, lenders, co-developers, consultants, trades and community organizations work with LCH because we take projects from site to keys under one roof: acquisition, approvals, design, financing, construction and leasing.

proof.label: Rental homes at Everston, Cliffside and Retreat
Communities on the Kingston Road corridor

items.title: Landowners & brokers
items.body: Have a site, a church, a plaza or an assembly? We move quickly to evaluate it, and we’re comfortable with heritage buildings, ravine edges and complex approvals.

items.title: Capital partners & lenders
items.body: Equity and debt for purpose-built rental and mixed-use projects, with development and construction managed in-house and reporting that shares the bad news as promptly as the good.

items.title: Co-developers & operators
items.body: We bring local knowledge, an approvals track record and a construction team. You bring scale, operations or a complementary platform.

items.title: Community organizations
items.body: Places of worship, non-profits and neighbourhood groups: we look for ways a project can restore a building, house a congregation or give space back to the community.

items.title: Architects & consultants
items.body: Planners, architects, engineers and specialists who want an owner that engages early, decides quickly and builds what gets designed.

items.title: Trades & suppliers
items.body: Through Elevate, we run our own sites and build long-term relationships with trades, including Canadian union trades, and suppliers who deliver on schedule.

items.title: Property management & leasing
items.body: As our rental portfolio grows, we partner with operators, leasing teams and service providers who care about residents as much as we do.

items.title: Development and construction under one roof
items.body: Elevate Construction Management, our affiliated construction manager, is involved from pre-construction onward, so the team that prices a project is the team that builds it.
items.proof: Everston went from demolition in March 2025 to a reported top-off by October 2026.

items.title: We know the neighbourhoods
items.body: We’ve been investing in east Toronto since 2007 and our office is on Kingston Road. Five of our eight communities are on the corridor.
items.proof: Merge Condos, Merge Spaces, Cliffside, Retreat and Everston.

items.title: We take on complex sites
items.body: Heritage churches, ravine-edge lots and multi-parcel assemblies are where we do our best work.
items.proof: St. Leslieville restored a 1913 church as 14 lofts; 415 Broadview pairs heritage restoration with new rental housing.

items.title: We adapt the plan when the market moves
items.body: We’d rather rethink a project than force it. That protects partners’ capital and gets homes built.
items.proof: Cliffside launched as condominiums in 2024 and is now under construction as 209 rental homes.

items.title: Transparent by default
items.body: Partners, investors and lenders get industry-leading reporting on every project, and we share negative news as promptly as positive.
items.proof: Transparency is one of our three company values.

items.title: We deliver
items.body: Condominiums, townhomes, lofts, a workspace and now purpose-built rentals, completed and occupied.
items.proof: Merge Condos, One6Nine Jones, St. Leslieville and Merge Spaces are complete.

criteria.heading: What we look for
items: Purpose-built rental, condominium or mixed tenure
Sites needing rezoning or Official Plan amendments
Toronto and the wider GTA, with deep roots in the east end

steps.title: Introduce
steps.body: Tell us about the site, the capital or the idea. We’ll respond quickly.

steps.title: Evaluate
steps.body: We study zoning, massing, market and costs, with input from Elevate on constructability.

steps.title: Structure
steps.body: We agree on a structure that fits: joint venture, land partnership or development management.

steps.title: Approve & build
steps.body: We lead approvals, design and construction, with regular reporting throughout.

steps.title: Deliver
steps.body: We bring the community to market and stay involved through lease-up and beyond.

form.heading: Start a conversation
form.intro: Share a few details and the right person on our team will get back to you. Everything you send is kept confidential.
